api_note: thegoankitchen.com returns available_fonts: null — FALLBACK_FONTS activates correctly for this restaurant
root_cause: When API returns available_fonts with ANY items, the API list is used directly instead of FALLBACK_FONTS. The screenshot shows 18+ fonts — this restaurant has available_fonts populated by backend with more fonts than the 11 approved ones.
fix_required: ALWAYS use FALLBACK_FONTS (rename to APPROVED_FONTS). Ignore the API list entirely. The approved 11 fonts are a product decision, not data-driven.
